guidance.statement: We are targeting INR450 to INR500 crores full year revenue between OSAT and PCB.
guidance.quote: and we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time, we are on the target.
guidance.speaker: N. Muthukumar

growth_commentary: Total revenue grew 40% year-on-year to INR946 crores, largely driven by EMS business.
Standalone EMS business grew 53% from INR480 crores to INR639 crores.
Smart metering business saw flat to negative growth of minus 12% due to working capital constraints and flood impacts.
Overseas entities grew 327% from INR24 crores to INR102 crores due to the August Electronics acquisition.

pushback.question: Are there any thought processes to divest the metering business to release working capital and management bandwidth?
pushback.answer: Management is seriously looking at options and opportunities to de-risk receivables and will update by February.

pushback.topic: Margin Pressure and Component Cost Inflation
pushback.question: Will gross margins compress in the coming 9 months due to component shortages and price increases?
pushback.answer: Management acknowledged it is a difficult year with pricing and availability pressures, though order pricing is generally pass-on.

pushback.topic: Working Capital and Negative Cash Flow
pushback.question: How did the cash flow from operations turn out, given the negative CFO and inventory build-up?
pushback.answer: Operating cash flow was negative INR259 crores, driven by inventory addition of INR177 crores and metering receivables.
